decisive_items: 7 cm × 5 cm × 5 cm heterogenous left adrenal mass containing regions of necrosis
local extension into and invasion of the pancreatic tail, left hemidiaphragm, and spleen
response.rationale: Large heterogeneous adrenal mass with necrosis and local invasion is classic for adrenal cortical carcinoma; lymphoma is less likely given the dominant adrenal mass and absence of diffuse nodal disease.

rejected.why: Autoimmune adrenalitis would not produce a large necrotic invasive mass.
No primary renal mass described; family history alone insufficient.
Same as R2; no evidence of primary renal cell carcinoma.
Lacks typical pheochromocytoma symptoms; mass features more consistent with carcinoma.
